scope_note: This is Freud's 1915 theoretical definition of repression. Recording it does not independently demonstrate that the proposed mechanism occurs.
statement: Freud's 1915 account defined repression as preventing an instinct-representing idea from becoming conscious rather than abolishing or destroying it.
statement_zh: Freud 在 1915 年把壓抑界定為阻止代表本能的表象進入意識，而不是將它消除或摧毀。
